# Vendored elisp

Third-party libraries the emacs child loads (`-L vendor`), copied in verbatim
and embedded into the pod binary (see `src/elisp.rs`).

| Library | Upstream | Pinned |
|---|---|---|
| `cljbang.el`, `cljbang-core.el`, `cljbang-string.el` | https://github.com/borkdude/cljbang.el | `f18da3e525a2b9975b5fd0d476822375448789c9` (MIT) |
| `parseclj.el`, `parseclj-alist.el`, `parseclj-ast.el`, `parseclj-lex.el`, `parseclj-parser.el` | https://github.com/clojure-emacs/parseclj | `ca828c202c026e45bd60503984cf510d904cae50` (GPL-3.0) |
| `parseedn.el` | https://github.com/clojure-emacs/parseedn | `1a28a88e2aabd99b41e02f491d6b8874ec128d7d` (GPL-3.0) |
| `a.el` | https://github.com/plexus/a.el | `93e5ed8c495794d1ba3c04b43041b95ce01079b1` (GPL-3.0) |
| `bencode.el` | https://github.com/skeeto/emacs-bencode | `b5fe9c9d4b9b5ea61cedd77987ca46eb8154bd16` (Unlicense) |

To bump: `bb vendor` (all) or `bb vendor <lib> ...` where lib is one of
cljbang, parseclj, parseedn, a, bencode. Then run `bb test`.
This table is generated by scripts/vendor.clj — edit `libs` there, not here.
`cljbang-mode.el` is intentionally not vendored — it is interactive-only.
